prompt: A rustic wooden fence runs horizontally across the middle ground, separating the viewer from the main activity. In the center foreground, a farmer in denim overalls and a plaid shirt holds a metal bucket, pouring grain into a trough. A speckled hen pecks at the spilled grain near his muddy boots on the left. To the right, a brown goat with curved horns leans its head over the fence, eating from the farmer's other hand. Behind the fence, a child in a red dress sits on an overturned crate, holding a white rabbit gently in their lap. A black and white border collie lies on the dry grass in the lower right, watching the goat intently. An old rusty tractor with large rear tires occupies the background left, partially obscured by hanging laundry lines with white sheets fluttering in the breeze. A scarecrow wearing a straw hat stands sentinel in the far background center. Sunlight filters through leafy branches above, casting dappled shadows on the dirt ground. The scene is bathed in warm afternoon light, highlighting dust motes in the air. The style is a photorealistic photo.
